from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Split at the all-zero separator.
    sep_row = next((r for r in range(h) if all(v == 0 for v in grid[r])), None)
    sep_col = next((c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 0 for r in range(h))), None)

    if sep_row is not None:
        a, b = grid[:sep_row], grid[sep_row + 1:]
    else:
        a = [row[:sep_col] for row in grid]
        b = [row[sep_col + 1:] for row in grid]

    ah, aw = len(a), len(a[0])
    bh, bw = len(b), len(b[0])
    bg_a = Counter(v for row in a for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    bg_b = Counter(v for row in b for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    return [
        [3 if a[r][c] == bg_a and b[r][c] == bg_b else 9
         for c in range(min(aw, bw))]
        for r in range(min(ah, bh))
    ]

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Locate the uniform divider between the two matching panels.
    divider = None
    for r in range(1, h - 1):
        if len(set(grid[r])) == 1:
            divider = ("row", r)
            break
    if divider is None:
        for c in range(1, w - 1):
            if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1:
                divider = ("col", c)
                break

    if divider[0] == "row":
        k = divider[1]
        first, second = grid[:k], grid[k + 1:]
        common = set(v for row in first for v in row) & set(v for row in second for v in row)
        other = Counter(v for row in first for v in row if v in common).most_common(1)[0][0]
        return [[3 if first[r][c] == second[r][c] else other
                 for c in range(len(first[0]))]
                for r in range(len(first))]
    else:
        k = divider[1]
        first = [row[:k] for row in grid]
        second = [row[k + 1:] for row in grid]
        common = set(v for row in first for v in row) & set(v for row in second for v in row)
        other = Counter(v for row in first for v in row if v in common).most_common(1)[0][0]
        return [[3 if first[r][c] == second[r][c] else other
                 for c in range(len(first[0]))]
